caveats.differentPopulation: The after arm produces different puzzles from today: on Nightmare and Hell 1 about 1 to 3 more clues per puzzle at a similar score, so part of the speed-up comes from a different puzzle population, not only from a faster search of the same puzzles.
likeWithLike: The estimate column holds the analysts' P1 to P5 rows at four workers (R02 to R08), not the after-all-phases values (R31); the R31 values are shown apart.
The estimates were applied to MP12b1's 20-seed T10 medians, while the measurements use 3 to 6 seeds, including seeds that today never finishes (a request that does not reach ten has no T10).
The estimates assumed today's puzzles (the same clue counts and scores); the after arm's puzzles differ (population section).
